summary: A firmware for medieval and fantasy live-action roleplay: acoustic-style physical-model instruments, a four-track composing mode and a scene mode for scoring a game live. Still in early hardware testing.
features: 20 instruments: harps, lutes, hurdy-gurdy, bagpipe, shawm, choir, organs, war drums
Bardic Crafting: four tracks, 64-step sequencer, microtiming, p-locks, live looping
Encounter: 16 scenes on white keys, 11 variations on black keys, bar-quantized crossfades
Scale Lock, eleven modes and four historical temperaments
Hidden Modern Mode adds subtractive and FM synth voices
Autosave every 30 seconds; USB audio and MIDI not yet confirmed on hardware
